exercises.name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip, elbows under the wrist.
Brace your core and keep your ribcage stacked over your pelvis rather than leaning back.
Press the bar straight overhead in a strict, controlled path until your arms are fully locked out.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat without using leg drive.

exercises.name: Backlash with Dumbbells
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down, chest up.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out and back until they're roughly in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back in a rack, step out, and stand with feet just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core, then bend your hips and knees to descend until your hip crease drops below your knee.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes throughout the descent.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up to full hip and knee extension.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and grip just outside your legs.
Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending hips and knees to full triple extension, then pull yourself under the bar to catch it on your front shoulders in a front squat position (the clean).
Stand fully upright with the bar racked on your shoulders.
Dip slightly at the knees, then drive explosively upward, punching the bar overhead while splitting or squatting your feet to catch it with arms locked out (the jerk).
Recover both feet to a stable stance with the bar locked out overhead before lowering it back to the floor.

exercises.name: Clean and Press
instructions: Set up over the bar and pull it explosively from the floor to your shoulders, catching it in a front rack position (the clean).
Stand fully upright with the bar racked on your shoulders, elbows up.
Press the bar strictly overhead until your arms are locked out, without using leg drive.
Lower the bar back to the shoulders, then to the floor with control between reps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms facing forward.
Press both dumbbells straight up until your arms are fully extended, without locking out aggressively.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to chest level, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your torso.
Repeat for the desired number of reps, keeping your shoulder blades pinned to the bench throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise to Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
Without pausing, sweep the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms form a T at shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back down the same path with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Split Squats
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step one foot forward into a staggered stance.
Lower straight down by bending both knees until your rear knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee tracking over your front foot.
Drive through your front heel to return to the start, completing all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Reverse Fly
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench set to roughly 30-45 degrees, a light dumbbell in each hand hanging below you.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they're roughly in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One-Legged Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in the opposite hand, a slight bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward at the hips, extending your free leg straight back for balance as the kettlebell lowers toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips square until the kettlebell approaches shin height or your hamstring flexibility limit.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, completing all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pass-Through Lunge
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and step forward into a lunge, lowering your rear knee toward the floor.
As you descend, pass the kettlebell under your front leg to your other hand.
Drive back up to standing, then step forward on the other leg and repeat the pass-through.
Keep your torso upright and core braced throughout the sequence.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curls
instructions: Lie face-down on the leg curl machine with the pad resting just above your heels.
Grip the handles and curl your heels toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement without lifting your hips off the pad.
Lower the pad back down with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Machine Squat
instructions: Position yourself in the squat machine with shoulders under the pads and feet set shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety and bend your knees to lower into a squat, keeping your chest up.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the platform.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your thighs, palms facing back.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms straight up in front of you and overhead.
Pause briefly at the top with arms fully raised.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise (Partial Reps)
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arms straight and torso stationary, raise the dumbbells out to your sides until they reach shoulder height.
Hold the contraction briefly at the top.
Lower the dumbbells only partway back down before raising them again, keeping continuous tension on your shoulders throughout the set.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Face away from a low cable pulley, straddling the cable with a rope attachment between your legs.
Hinge forward at the hips, letting the rope pull your arms back between your legs, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward explosively, standing tall and squeezing your glutes at the top.
Control the weight back down into the next hinge and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Push your hips back while keeping a slight bend in your knees, lowering the dumbbells along your legs.
Keep your back flat and lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and press the bar straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Keep your back against the bench pad throughout the press.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in the calf raise machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and pads resting on your thighs.
Lower your heels as far as comfortable to feel a stretch in your calves.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Keep your back against the bench pad throughout the press.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Keep your back against the bench pad throughout the press.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, the other hand free or bracing on a support.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbow, raise the dumbbell out to the side until your arm is roughly parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulder up.
Lower the dumbbell back down with control, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Palm-In Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand, palm facing inward toward your head.
Brace your core and press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm locks out.
Keep your torso upright without leaning to the working side.
Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder height with control, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Cable Hip Extension
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and secure it around one ankle, facing the machine.
Hinge slightly forward and hold the machine for balance on your standing leg.
Extend the cuffed leg straight back and up by squeezing your glute.
Return to the starting position with control, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent, and the other leg extended straight up.
Brace your core and drive through the planted heel to lift your hips off the floor.
Squeeze your glute at the top, keeping your hips level.
Lower back down with control, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Position the balls of your feet on a raised platform under a Smith machine bar resting on your upper traps.
Lower your heels as far as comfortable to feel a stretch in your calves.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and glutes to keep your ribcage stacked over your pelvis.
Press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Standing Palms-In Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
Brace your core and press both dumbbells straight overhead, keeping the neutral grip throughout.
Lock out fully at the top without letting the dumbbells drift forward.
Lower back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Step-Up with Knee Raise
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench, one foot planted on top.
Drive through the planted foot to stand up onto the box, keeping your torso upright.
As you reach the top, drive your trailing knee up toward your chest for balance and hip drive.
Step back down with control and repeat, alternating legs.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row with Handle
instructions: Straddle the T-bar with a V-handle attached, feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is at roughly 45 degrees, back flat, and grip the handle.
Pull the handle up toward your chest, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the weight back down with control until your arms are extended and repeat.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and raise one leg so your hip and knee are both bent to roughly 90 degrees.
Clasp your hands behind the thigh for support, keeping your lower back flat on the floor.
Slowly straighten the raised leg toward the ceiling until you feel a stretch in the hamstring.
Hold, then bend the knee back to 90 degrees and repeat, or switch legs.

exercises.name: Alternating Lunge Jump
instructions: Start in a lunge position with one foot forward and one back, both knees bent roughly 90 degrees.
Explosively jump straight up, swapping leg positions in the air.
Land softly back in a lunge with the opposite leg forward, absorbing the impact through your hips and knees.
Immediately repeat, alternating legs each jump.

exercises.name: Band Good Morning
instructions: Anchor a resistance band low behind you and loop it across your upper back and shoulders, facing away from the anchor.
Stand with feet hip-width apart, a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat, until your torso is close to parallel with the floor.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the bar over your mid-foot, and grip it just outside your legs.
Bend your hips and knees to grip the bar, keeping your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your whole foot, extending your hips and knees together to stand the bar up.
Lock out fully at the top with hips and knees extended, then lower the bar back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell rolled over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, then lower your hips back down with control before the next rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell rolled over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, then lower your hips back down with control before the next rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell rolled over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, then lower your hips back down with control before the next rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell rolled over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, then lower your hips back down with control before the next rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell rolled over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent, shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to thrust your hips up until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Pause and squeeze at the top, then lower back down with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Stiff-Legged Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Keeping your legs nearly straight with only a slight knee bend, hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, keeping the bar close to your body.

exercises.name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back to load a quick countermovement.
Explosively swing your arms forward and jump onto the box, landing softly with knees bent.
Stand up fully on the box, then step back down and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Box Jump (Multiple Response)
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump onto the box, landing softly with knees bent.
Immediately jump back down to the floor, absorbing the landing.
Without pausing, jump straight back up onto the box, repeating the cycle for the target number of reps.

exercises.name: Calf Press on the Leg Press Machine
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine with only the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, legs extended.
Release the safety catches and let your heels drop below the platform to stretch your calves.
Press through the balls of your feet to push the platform away by extending your ankles.
Lower with control back to the stretched position and repeat.

exercises.name: Clean
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and grip just outside your legs.
Pull the bar from the floor, extending hips and knees explosively to full triple extension.
Pull yourself under the bar, catching it on your front shoulders in a front squat position.
Stand up fully to complete the lift, then lower the bar back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and grip just outside your legs.
Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending hips and knees to full triple extension, then pull yourself under the bar to catch it on your front shoulders in a front squat position (the clean).
Stand fully upright with the bar racked on your shoulders.
Dip slightly at the knees, then drive explosively upward, punching the bar overhead while splitting or squatting your feet to catch it with arms locked out (the jerk).
Recover both feet to a stable stance with the bar locked out overhead before lowering it back to the floor.

exercises.name: Clean and Press
instructions: Set up over the bar and pull it explosively from the floor to your shoulders, catching it in a front rack position (the clean).
Stand fully upright with the bar racked on your shoulders, elbows up.
Press the bar strictly overhead until your arms are locked out, without using leg drive.
Lower the bar back to the shoulders, then to the floor with control between reps.

exercises.name: Clean Deadlift
instructions: Set up over the bar in your clean starting position, feet hip-width apart, grip just outside your legs.
Keeping your back flat and the bar close to your shins, drive through your legs to stand the bar up.
Move deliberately and under control rather than exploding, unlike a full clean pull.
Lock out at the top with hips fully extended, then lower the bar back to the floor and reset.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Plank Hold
instructions: Lie face-down on top of an exercise ball with your stomach resting on the ball.
Walk your hands forward along the floor as the ball rolls back under your hips and legs.
Extend your elbows and knees fully, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your ankles, with only your shins or feet resting on the ball.
Hold the position, keeping your core braced, then walk your hands back to return the ball under your torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Clean
instructions: Stand over a pair of dumbbells with feet hip-width apart and hinge down to grip them.
Pull the dumbbells explosively upward, extending your hips and knees, then shrug and pull with your arms.
Drop under the dumbbells to catch them at shoulder height, elbows up, in a quarter-squat.
Stand up fully to complete the rep, then lower the dumbbells back to the floor and reset.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
instructions: Stand between two heavy dumbbells, one on each side of your feet.
Hinge at the hips to grip both dumbbells, then stand up tall with your shoulders back and core braced.
Walk forward for the target distance in controlled, even steps, keeping the dumbbells close to your sides.
Set the dumbbells down with control at the end of the distance rather than dropping them.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise to Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
Without pausing, sweep the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms form a T at shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back down the same path with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation
instructions: Lie on a bench with your forearm supported and wrist hanging off the edge, holding a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Starting from a neutral wrist position, rotate your forearm to turn the dumbbell further into pronation (palm further downward).
Rotate back to the starting position with control.
Complete all reps on one arm before switching sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Supination
instructions: Lie on a bench with your forearm supported and wrist hanging off the edge, holding a light dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Starting from a neutral wrist position, rotate your forearm to turn the dumbbell further into supination (palm further upward).
Rotate back to the starting position with control.
Complete all reps on one arm before switching sides.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Hip Thrust
instructions: Lie on your back with your upper back and shoulders resting on an exercise ball, feet flat on the floor.
Bend your knees to roughly 90 degrees, keeping the ball stable under your shoulders.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to raise your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Lower back down with control, keeping your balance on the ball throughout.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Leg Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels resting on top of an exercise ball, arms flat at your sides.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Keeping your hips raised, roll the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Extend your legs back out to roll the ball away, keeping your hips up throughout.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and hands tucked under your glutes for lower-back support.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor and brace your core.
Alternate small, rapid up-and-down kicks with straight legs.
Keep your lower back pressed toward the floor throughout the set.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back in a rack, step out, and stand with feet just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core, then bend your hips and knees to descend until your hip crease drops below your knee.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes throughout the descent.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up to full hip and knee extension.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Brace your core and drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge Hamstring Walkout
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, and lift your hips into a bridge position.
Keeping your hips raised and level, walk your feet forward a small step, straightening one leg slightly.
Continue walking your feet out until your legs are nearly straight while maintaining the bridge.
Walk your feet back in to the starting position, keeping your hips up throughout.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Position your feet against the footplate of a glute-ham machine, knees on the pad, torso upright.
Keeping your body in a straight line, slowly lower your torso forward by extending your knees.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch or approach the floor, staying under control.
Curl back up by driving your heels into the plate and contracting your hamstrings to return to upright.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Position your feet against the footplate of a glute-ham machine, knees on the pad, torso upright.
Keeping your body in a straight line, slowly lower your torso forward by extending your knees.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch or approach the floor, staying under control.
Curl back up by driving your heels into the plate and contracting your hamstrings to return to upright.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback
instructions: Position yourself in the glute kickback machine with one foot on the platform pad.
Brace your core and hold the handles for stability.
Kick the working leg straight back and up by squeezing your glute.
Return with control to the starting position, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Good Morning
instructions: Position a barbell across your upper back as if setting up for a squat, feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping a slight bend in your knees and your back flat, hinge forward at the hips.
Lower your torso until it's roughly parallel to the floor or you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Good Morning off Pins
instructions: Set safety pins in a rack at hip height and position a barbell across your upper back, starting from a hinged position resting against the pins.
Brace your core, then drive your hips forward to stand the bar up off the pins.
Keeping a slight knee bend and flat back, hinge back down until the bar returns to the pins.
Repeat, using the pins to fix your starting depth each rep.

exercises.name: Hamstring Self-Myofascial Release
instructions: Sit on the floor with a foam roller placed under one thigh, hands supporting your weight behind you.
Cross your other leg over for added pressure if desired.
Slowly roll from just above the knee to just below the glute, pausing on any tender spots.
Continue for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch
instructions: Stand holding the bar at hip or upper-thigh height with a wide snatch grip.
Hinge slightly at the hips to load, then explosively extend your hips and knees, shrugging the bar upward.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it overhead with arms locked out in a quarter-squat.
Stand up fully to complete the lift, then lower the bar back down under control.

exercises.name: Hip Extension with Bands
instructions: Anchor a resistance band low behind you and loop the other end around one ankle.
Get on all fours or stand holding a support, facing the anchor.
Keeping your leg mostly straight, extend it back and up against the band's resistance by squeezing your glute.
Return with control, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Hip Lift with Band
instructions: Lie on your back with a resistance band looped just above your knees, feet flat and knees bent.
Press your knees out slightly against the band's tension to engage your glutes.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower back down with control, keeping tension on the band throughout.

exercises.name: Hurdle Hops
instructions: Set up a line of low hurdles or markers spaced a comfortable jump apart.
Stand with feet together at the start of the line.
Jump over each hurdle with both feet together, using a quick arm swing for momentum.
Land softly and immediately jump into the next hurdle, minimizing ground contact time.

exercises.name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, then bend forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward into a plank position, keeping your legs as straight as comfortable.
Hold the plank briefly, then walk your feet forward toward your hands, keeping legs straight.
Stand back up to complete one rep and repeat.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Reverse Fly
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench set to roughly 30-45 degrees, a light dumbbell in each hand hanging below you.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they're roughly in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One-Legged Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in the opposite hand, a slight bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward at the hips, extending your free leg straight back for balance as the kettlebell lowers toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips square until the kettlebell approaches shin height or your hamstring flexibility limit.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, completing all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive up explosively out of the squat, using the momentum to press the kettlebells overhead.
Lower the kettlebells back to shoulder height as you descend into the next squat.

exercises.name: Knee Across the Body Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Bend one knee and pull it across your body toward the opposite side with your hand.
Keep both shoulders flat on the floor while you feel a stretch through your glute and lower back.
Hold, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Knee Across the Body Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Bend one knee and pull it across your body toward the opposite side with your hand.
Keep both shoulders flat on the floor while you feel a stretch through your glute and lower back.
Hold, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Knee Tuck Jump
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in an athletic stance.
Bend your knees slightly and swing your arms back to load a countermovement.
Jump straight up, driving both knees up toward your chest at the peak of the jump.
Land softly with knees bent, absorbing the impact, then reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Kneeling Jump Squat
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your torso upright and toes tucked under.
Swing your arms and explosively drive your hips forward to jump your feet under you into a squat stance.
Land softly in a squat position with feet flat.
Reset back to kneeling with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Barbell Kneeling Squat
instructions: Set the bar to the appropriate height in a power rack and kneel behind it on a padded surface.
Slide under the bar and rack it across the back of your shoulders, as in a standard back squat.
Unrack the bar, then sit back with your glutes until they touch your calves, keeping your torso upright.
Reverse the motion, driving back up to the kneeling starting position, and repeat.

exercises.name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back near a wall or door frame and extend one leg up against it, resting your heel on the surface.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor, extended straight.
Scoot your hips closer to the wall until you feel a stretch in the raised leg's hamstring.
Hold, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Linear Acceleration Wall Drill
instructions: Lean forward against a wall with hands at shoulder height, body in a straight line from head to the back foot.
Drive one knee up toward hip height in a sprint-start position, foot dorsiflexed.
Drive that foot down and back explosively as if accelerating into a sprint, then switch legs.
Continue alternating legs at a fast, controlled cadence, keeping your body angle consistent.

exercises.name: Lying Glute Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Reach through and grasp the back of the uncrossed thigh, pulling it toward your chest.
Hold to feel a stretch in the crossed leg's glute, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Lying Glute Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Reach through and grasp the back of the uncrossed thigh, pulling it toward your chest.
Hold to feel a stretch in the crossed leg's glute, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Lying Groin Stretch with Band
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a resistance band around one foot, holding the ends in your hand.
Extend that leg straight up, then let it fall out to the side, controlled by the band's tension.
Keep your opposite hip pressed into the floor as you lower the leg toward the ground.
Hold to feel a stretch in the inner thigh, then return and switch sides.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Raise one leg, clasping your hands behind the thigh or calf.
Gently pull the leg toward your chest, keeping the knee as straight as comfortable.
Hold, then lower and switch legs.

exercises.name: Military Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and glutes so your ribcage stays stacked over your pelvis.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly to let the bar pass, then forward to lock out directly over your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Military Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and glutes so your ribcage stays stacked over your pelvis.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly to let the bar pass, then forward to lock out directly over your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Military Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and glutes so your ribcage stays stacked over your pelvis.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly to let the bar pass, then forward to lock out directly over your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Military Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and glutes so your ribcage stays stacked over your pelvis.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly to let the bar pass, then forward to lock out directly over your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Sprint Claw Drill
instructions: Jog or run forward at a moderate pace, focusing on your foot strike pattern.
As your hip extends, flex your knee to kick your heel up toward your glutes.
Reload your leg by driving the knee forward, then aggressively claw your foot down and back into the ground directly under your hips.
Pump your arms in a rapid punching motion to match your leg cadence, and continue for the target distance.

exercises.name: Natural Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles secured by a partner or anchor, torso upright.
Keeping your body in a straight line from knees to shoulders, slowly lower your torso toward the floor.
Use your hamstrings to control the descent as long as possible before catching yourself with your hands.
Push off the floor and curl your hamstrings to pull yourself back to the upright starting position.

exercises.name: Neck Bridge (Supine)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, close to your glutes.
Tuck your chin and press the back of your head lightly into the floor.
Bridge your hips slightly and roll your weight toward the top of your head, supporting most of your weight with your feet and hands.
Hold briefly under control, then lower back down gently.

exercises.name: One Knee to Chest Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Bend one knee and pull it toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your other leg flat on the floor and your lower back pressed down.
Hold, then lower and switch legs.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your thighs, palms facing back.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms straight up in front of you and overhead.
Pause briefly at the top with arms fully raised.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

exercises.name: Palms-Down Wrist Curl over Bench
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs or the bench, wrists hanging off the edge, palms facing down, holding a barbell.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingertips, extending your wrists.
Curl the bar back up by flexing your wrists as far as possible.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Palms-Up Dumbbell Wrist Curl over a Bench
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists hanging off the edge, palms facing up, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Let the dumbbells roll down toward your fingertips, extending your wrists.
Curl the dumbbells back up by flexing your wrists as far as possible.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Palms-Up Wrist Curl over Bench
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists hanging off the edge, palms facing up, holding a barbell.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingertips, extending your wrists.
Curl the bar back up by flexing your wrists as far as possible.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Piriformis Self-Myofascial Release
instructions: Sit on a foam roller with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee.
Lean toward the crossed side and support your weight with your hands behind you.
Slowly roll over the glute area, pausing on tender spots.
Continue for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Power Clean
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and grip just outside your legs.
Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending your hips and knees to full triple extension.
Pull yourself under the bar, catching it on your shoulders in a partial, quarter-squat position (higher than a full clean catch).
Stand up fully to complete the lift, then lower the bar back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Power Clean from Blocks
instructions: Set the bar on lifting blocks at or above knee height and set up over it with feet hip-width apart.
Pull the bar explosively off the blocks, extending your hips and knees to full triple extension.
Pull yourself under the bar, catching it on your shoulders in a quarter-squat position.
Stand up fully to complete the lift, then return the bar to the blocks under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise (Partial Reps)
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arms straight and torso stationary, raise the dumbbells out to your sides until they reach shoulder height.
Hold the contraction briefly at the top.
Lower the dumbbells only partway back down before raising them again, keeping continuous tension on your shoulders throughout the set.

exercises.name: Power Snatch
instructions: Set up over the bar with a wide snatch grip, feet hip-width apart.
Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending your hips and knees to full triple extension.
Pull yourself under the bar, catching it overhead with arms locked out in a quarter-squat position.
Stand up fully to complete the lift, then lower the bar back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face-down on a reverse hyper machine with your hips at the edge of the pad and legs hanging below on the swing.
Grip the handles in front of you for stability.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to swing your legs up until they're in line with your torso.
Lower back down with control, allowing a gentle stretch at the bottom, and repeat.

exercises.name: Rickshaw Carry
instructions: Step inside a loaded rickshaw/yoke-style carry frame and grip the handles at your sides.
Stand up tall to lift the load, bracing your core and keeping your chest up.
Walk forward for the target distance in short, controlled steps.
Set the frame down with control at the end of the distance rather than dropping it.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at hip height with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
Push your hips back while keeping a slight bend in your knees, lowering the bar along your legs.
Keep your back flat and lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift from Deficit
instructions: Stand on a small platform (1-2 inches) holding a barbell at hip height, feet hip-width apart.
Push your hips back while keeping a slight bend in your knees, lowering the bar along your legs.
Use the extra depth from the platform to lower further than a standard Romanian deadlift, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and press the bar straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Keep your back against the bench pad throughout the press.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Keep your back against the bench pad throughout the press.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Keep your back against the bench pad throughout the press.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Finger Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip, forearms resting on your thighs, wrists at the edge.
Let the bar roll down out of your palms toward your fingertips.
Curl your fingers to close your grip and roll the bar back up into your palms.
Repeat, keeping the movement isolated to your fingers rather than your wrists.

exercises.name: Seated Glute Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with both legs extended.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, letting the bent knee fall out to the side.
Lean your torso forward over your legs, keeping your back flat, until you feel a stretch in the crossed leg's glute.
Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in the leg curl machine with the back pad resting just above your heels and thighs secured under the leg pad.
Grip the handles and curl your heels down and back by bending your knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the bottom of the movement.
Return with control to the starting position and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm on your thigh, wrist hanging off the knee, palm facing up, holding a dumbbell.
Let the dumbbell roll down toward your fingertips, extending your wrist.
Curl the dumbbell back up by flexing your wrist as far as possible.
Complete all reps on one arm before switching sides.

exercises.name: Seated Palms-Down Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists hanging off the edge, palms facing down, holding a barbell.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingertips, extending your wrists.
Curl the bar back up by flexing your wrists as far as possible.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Palms-Down Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists hanging off the edge, palms facing down, holding a barbell.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingertips, extending your wrists.
Curl the bar back up by flexing your wrists as far as possible.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Palms-Up Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists hanging off the edge, palms facing up, holding a barbell.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingertips, extending your wrists.
Curl the bar back up by flexing your wrists as far as possible.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit facing a low cable pulley with a straight bar attachment, forearms resting on your thighs, palms facing up.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingertips, extending your wrists.
Curl the bar back up by flexing your wrists as far as possible.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet hip-width apart and hinge down to grip the handle.
Hike the kettlebell back slightly, then drive your hips forward explosively to swing it upward.
Guide the kettlebell close to your body as it rises, snapping your wrist to catch it in the rack position at your shoulder.
Lower the kettlebell back down between your legs with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, gripping a kettlebell with one hand in front of you.
Hinge at the hips to swing the kettlebell back between your legs, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward explosively to swing the kettlebell up to chest height, arm relaxed.
Let the kettlebell swing back down and repeat, keeping the movement powered by your hips.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, the other hand free or bracing on a support.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbow, raise the dumbbell out to the side until your arm is roughly parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulder up.
Lower the dumbbell back down with control, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Palm-In Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand, palm facing inward toward your head.
Brace your core and press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm locks out.
Keep your torso upright without leaning to the working side.
Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder height with control, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in the opposite hand, a slight bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward at the hips, extending your free leg straight back for balance as the kettlebell lowers toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips square throughout the descent.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, completing all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.name: Sled Push
instructions: Load the sled with an appropriate weight and stand behind it, gripping the upright handles.
Lean forward from the ankles, keeping your back flat and core braced.
Drive through the balls of your feet with short, powerful steps to push the sled forward.
Continue for the target distance, maintaining a consistent low body angle throughout.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Stiff-Legged Deadlift
instructions: Stand under a Smith machine bar set at hip height, feet hip-width apart, and grip the bar.
Unrack the bar and keeping your legs nearly straight, hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing and repeat.

exercises.name: Snatch Deadlift
instructions: Set up over the bar with a wide snatch grip, feet hip-width apart.
Keeping your back flat and the bar close to your shins, drive through your legs to stand the bar up deliberately.
Finish with a shrug at the top, keeping the movement controlled rather than explosive.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control and reset for the next rep.

exercises.name: Standing Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with an overhand grip, arms relaxed at your sides.
Let the bar roll down out of your hands, extending your wrists.
Curl the bar back up by flexing your wrists as far as possible.
Repeat, keeping your arms still and the movement isolated to your wrists.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and glutes to keep your ribcage stacked over your pelvis.
Press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand and place one heel on a low step or ledge, leg straight, toes pointing up.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat, reaching toward your raised foot.
Hold to feel a stretch through the hamstring and calf of the raised leg.
Return upright, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Extension
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and secure it around one ankle, facing the machine.
Hold the machine frame for balance, standing tall on your non-working leg.
Keeping a slight knee bend, extend the cuffed leg straight back by squeezing your glute.
Return with control, completing all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Standing Leg Curl
instructions: Stand in the leg curl machine with the pad resting just above one heel, holding the frame for balance.
Curl your heel up toward your glute by bending your knee.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top of the movement.
Lower with control, completing all reps before switching legs.

exercises.name: Standing Leg Swing
instructions: Stand holding a wall or support for balance.
Swing one leg forward and backward in a controlled arc, keeping your torso upright.
Gradually increase the range of motion as your hips loosen up.
Complete the target reps, then switch to side-to-side swings or the other leg.

exercises.name: Standing Palms-In Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
Brace your core and press both dumbbells straight overhead, keeping the neutral grip throughout.
Lock out fully at the top without letting the dumbbells drift forward.
Lower back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Standing Toe Touches
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Hinge forward from the hips, reaching your hands toward your toes.
Let your head and neck relax, keeping the movement slow and controlled.
Hold at the bottom, then roll back up to standing one vertebra at a time.

exercises.name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Keeping your legs nearly straight with only a slight knee bend, hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, keeping the dumbbells close to your body.

exercises.name: Straight-Bar Wrist Roll-Up
instructions: Hold a straight bar with a rope or cord attached at its center, a weight hanging from the other end of the cord, arms extended in front of you.
Roll the bar forward with alternating hand motions to wind the cord up and lift the weight.
Once fully wound, reverse the motion to slowly lower the weight back down.
Repeat for the target number of rolls.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out, the bar over your mid-foot.
Grip the bar with your hands inside your knees and drop your hips down, keeping your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your whole foot, pushing your knees out, extending your hips and knees together to stand the bar up.
Lock out fully at the top, then lower the bar back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: TRX Hip Thrust
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels secured in suspension straps set a few inches off the floor, knees bent.
Brace your core and drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower back down with control, keeping your heels stable in the straps throughout.

exercises.name: Seated Straddle Stretch
instructions: Sit upright on the floor and extend your legs out in front of you in a wide V shape.
Keeping your legs straight, place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Lean your torso forward as far as comfortable, reaching toward the floor between your legs.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, keeping your back as flat as possible.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring and Upper Back Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight out in front of you, knees together.
Bend forward and hug your thighs from underneath with both arms.
Keeping your legs extended, pull your chest down toward your knees until you feel a stretch through your hamstrings.
For an added middle-back stretch, gently pull your back away from your knees while continuing to hug them.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring and Upper Back Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight out in front of you, knees together.
Bend forward and hug your thighs from underneath with both arms.
Keeping your legs extended, pull your chest down toward your knees until you feel a stretch through your hamstrings.
For an added middle-back stretch, gently pull your back away from your knees while continuing to hug them.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Hinge at the hips to swing the dumbbell back between your legs, keeping your back flat.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles to drive the dumbbell forward and up toward chest or overhead height.
Let the dumbbell swing back down under control and repeat, powering the movement from your hips rather than your arms.

exercises.name: Wide Stance Stiff Legs
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out, holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
Keeping your legs nearly straight, hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a stretch through your hamstrings and inner thighs.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing and repeat.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step into a deep lunge with one foot forward, hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Drop your back knee down to feel a stretch in the hip flexor of your rear leg.
Rotate your torso and reach your inside arm up toward the ceiling, opening your chest.
Return your hand to the floor, straighten your front leg for a hamstring stretch, then step forward and switch sides.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
instructions: Hold a wrist roller device with both hands, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height, a weight hanging from the cord.
Roll the handle forward with alternating wrist motions to wind the cord up and lift the weight.
Once fully wound, reverse the motion to slowly lower the weight back down under control.
Repeat for the target number of rolls.

exercises.name: Front Squat
instructions: Rest the bar across the front of your shoulders in a front rack position, elbows up.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, core braced.
Bend your hips and knees to descend, keeping your torso upright and elbows high throughout.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up to full extension.

exercises.name: Push Press
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip slightly by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive explosively through your legs and press the bar overhead using the momentum, locking your arms out.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Snatch
instructions: Set up over the bar with a wide snatch grip, feet hip-width apart.
Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending your hips and knees to full triple extension.
Pull yourself under the bar, catching it overhead with arms locked out in a full squat.
Stand up fully to complete the lift, then lower the bar back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle.
Press the bar back up to full lockout, driving through your feet and keeping your shoulder blades pinned.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a bench set to a 30-45 degree incline, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it over your upper chest.
Lower the bar with control to your upper chest, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle.
Press the bar back up to full lockout and repeat.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is roughly 45 degrees, keeping your back flat.
Pull the bar up toward your lower ribcage, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar back down with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands just outside shoulder width, arms fully extended.
Brace your core and pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower back down with control to a full hang and repeat.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart, arms fully extended.
Brace your core and pull your chest up toward the bar, driving your elbows down and back.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower back down with control to a full hang and repeat.

exercises.name: Wall Ball Shot
instructions: Stand facing a wall, holding a medicine ball at chest height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Perform a full squat, keeping the ball close to your chest.
Drive up explosively out of the squat, extending your legs and hips, and throw the ball against a target on the wall above head height.
Catch the ball as it rebounds and immediately descend into the next rep.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes Wave
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance holding one end of a battle rope in each hand, arms extended in front of you.
Brace your core and slightly bend your knees.
Alternately whip each arm up and down to send waves through the ropes, keeping the motion continuous.
Maintain the pace for the target duration, keeping your core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine (Erg)
instructions: Sit on the rowing machine with feet strapped in and knees bent, holding the handle with arms extended.
Drive through your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribcage.
Reverse the sequence: extend your arms, lean forward, then bend your knees to return to the catch position.
Repeat in a smooth, continuous rhythm for the target distance or time.

exercises.name: Sandbag Carry
instructions: Load a sandbag and hug it against your chest, or hoist it onto one shoulder.
Brace your core and stand up tall, keeping the bag secure against your body.
Walk forward for the target distance in controlled, even steps.
Set the sandbag down with control at the end of the distance rather than dropping it.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
instructions: Attach a rope or straps to a loaded sled and stand facing it, gripping the rope in both hands.
Walk or step backward, pulling the sled toward you hand-over-hand or by walking back with the rope taut.
Keep your core braced and back flat throughout the pull.
Continue for the target distance, resetting the rope as needed.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in one hand, arm locked out straight above your shoulder, same-side knee bent with foot flat on the floor.
Press the kettlebell up and roll onto your opposite forearm, then push up onto your hand.
Sweep your back leg through to a kneeling lunge position, keeping the kettlebell locked out overhead the whole time.
Stand up from the lunge, then reverse each step in order to return to the floor.
Complete all reps on one side before switching arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Hold a barbell in a front rack position at your shoulders, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive up explosively out of the squat, using the momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar back to the shoulders as you descend into the next squat.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Step inside a loaded trap bar, feet hip-width apart, and grip the handles at your sides.
Bend your hips and knees to grip the handles, keeping your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your whole foot, extending your hips and knees together to stand the bar up.
Lock out fully at the top, then lower the bar back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand holding an EZ-curl bar on the angled grips with an underhand grip, arms extended, elbows at your sides.
Keeping your elbows pinned to your sides, curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without swinging your torso.
Lower the bar back down with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the jump rope handles at hip height, rope behind your heels.
Swing the rope overhead and jump just high enough to clear it as it passes under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, using small wrist rotations to turn the rope rather than big arm swings.
Continue at a steady rhythm for the target duration or rep count.
